name: wan22_still_t2i
description: Wan 2.2 14B 'Cinematic still': the installed wan22_t2v graph (two experts, lightx2v 4-step LoRAs, cfg 1, shift 5) rendering a single frame (latent length 1), decoded with VAEDecode and saved as a PNG. No new weights. Apache-2.0.

negative.default: oversaturated, overexposed, blurry details, subtitles, watermark, grey cast, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, ugly, deformed, extra fingers, bad hands, bad face, malformed limbs, cluttered background

requires.assumed: no official Wan 2.2 text-to-image template: one-frame sampling is our recipe; check the 4-step Lightning LoRAs hold up on a still, else try the experts without them at 20 steps cfg 3.5
